main_body: Flat ground paving patch of dark cobblestone/scale tiles, seamless repeating texture, 4x3 tiles
top_band: none (terrain texture, no standing body; column scan shows repeating tile pattern with no top band)
evidence: Terrain tile: a repeating cobble/scale ground texture viewed from above with no standing volume. The 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply, and nothing in it is a wall face drawn as a front elevation. It is a flat floor pattern, which is acceptable for terrain.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours in total and a median of 5 per tile, against 26 per tile and 80 colours in the grass reference. The paving reference is also low at 7 colours, but its stones carry light edge highlights and clear per-stone shading, and it has varied joint structure. The candidate's dark edge pixels are 100% neutral, so the dark joints read as neutral grey-black rather than tinted material tone. The scale pattern repeats mechanically with an identical motif and very little variation, which looks thin and stamped next to the references. There are no flat fills, since the pattern is dense, but with 5 colours and a strictly tiled repeat it is shallower than the Beodeul standard.
